hello2: I am Doğancan Okur aka faecon.
about-description: I am a software developer who builds modern, performant, and user-focused interfaces with web technologies. I focus on creating maintainable, sustainable, and clean solutions within the React, Next.js, and TypeScript ecosystem.
about-education: I completed my bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering at Yalova University in 2018, and my master's degree in Computer Engineering at Beykent University in 2023.
about-work: Since 2019, I have been working at Hitit Computer Services, where I continuously gain new knowledge and experience. During this time, I try to solve different problems every day and explore new technologies. As side projects, I continue developing computer games and learning new things about software development.
